raw_model_deviations.claim_in_article: Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.
raw_model_deviations.issue: Ledger reports a short-term movement in Brent crude futures, not a market-wide result for oil prices. The article extends that observation to the whole market.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The explicit phrase “across the whole market” broadens the Brent-specific observation in HF-009 into an unsupported market-wide claim.
same_fact_id_locations: The Fee Plan Leaves, But High Oil Prices Stay
Political statements changed greatly. Oil prices moved briefly, then returned to a high level.
The fee plan vanished, but oil prices stayed high as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz continued.
